prompt:
Warm editorial ink-and-wash illustration on a warm cream ground: a loose confident ink line with soft transparent watercolour washes over it, a muted earth palette of cream, rust, ochre, mustard, sage and warm grey, quiet and hand-made, the register of a good printed picture book. NOT neon, NOT 3D or CGI or Pixar, NOT glossy plastic, NOT neo-comic, NOT photoreal.

PORTRAIT CLOSING PLATE for a children's picture book. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OF ANY KIND anywhere in this image: no words, no letters, no title, no lettering, no signature, no numbers, no captions.

A quiet wide view of warm late-afternoon sky over a small back garden at dusk. THE SKY IS FULL OF PAPER PLANES AND NO TWO ARE THE SAME FOLD, exactly as in the attached study sheet: long thin darts, short fat ones, blunt-nosed ones, broad square ones, ones with upturned wingtips, one with a thick folded-over nose. They drift high and scattered at every angle, NOT in formation, NOT evenly spaced.

CRITICAL PAPER RULE: every plane is folded from PLAIN CREAM OR WHITE PAPER, the colour of ordinary writing paper, and two or three are folded from PRINTED paper such as newsprint or a bus timetable with small type visible on the folds. THERE ARE NO COLOURED PAPER PLANES AT ALL: no orange, no blue, no green, no teal, no red, no patterned or craft or origami paper. Only cream, white and newsprint.

Far below at the very bottom edge, small and distant, the low roof of a little timber shed with one warm lit window, and a mown garden ending in a wooden gate. NO PEOPLE and NO ROBOT anywhere in this image.

THE LOWER HALF OF THE FRAME MUST BE CALM, OPEN AND UNCLUTTERED, mostly soft empty sky and quiet ground, because a closing verse will be overlaid there. Keep all the busy detail in the upper half.

ONE single continuous full-bleed painting. Never a grid, never panels, never a study sheet layout.

READABLE SURFACES FACE THEIR READER: any book, page, letter, scroll or sign a character is reading or writing faces THAT CHARACTER, never the camera. Compose over-the-shoulder or from behind so the surface genuinely faces them. Any handwriting is abstract handwriting-like line work with NO real readable letters.

NO USER INTERFACE ANYWHERE: no windows, menu bars, buttons, icons, toolbars, panels, form fields, cursors, floating rectangles or screenshot-like elements. Screens carry only soft glow or vague painterly shapes.
